scope: Board coverage and hardware-rule consistency in application source and knowledge_base; attached Downloads/SKILL.md read as reference data only. Findings record observations before concurrent corrective edits by the root agent.

status_semantics.documented: A name or claimed pinout exists in Markdown; this alone is not runtime support.
status_semantics.build_enabled: A generic deployment route exists; it does not certify every revision/peripheral.
status_semantics.physical_tested: Requires actual board results. Current pilot validation explicitly records false.

findings.issue: iA SW2 is GPIO17 in README but GPIO14 in other rules
findings.action: Resolve by exact revision/source; do not let duplicate rules vote.

findings.issue: 32iP SW2 timeline=14 versus table=17 shared SERVO2
findings.action: Mark unresolved until revision-specific schematic/test resolves it.

findings.issue: RTC bus and KB-CHAIN routing are mixed across documents
findings.action: Separate physical net names, SDA/SCL pins and software controller ID.

findings.issue: Unconditional 32iA KXTJ3/phototransistor claims conflict with INEX page specifying iA-MC3479/LDR
findings.action: Represent variants/chip identity as unresolved; probe/register-check before selecting driver.

findings.status_at_observation: corrected in iKB-1.md by delegated agent
findings.issue: Old iKB document fabricated MCP23017-compatible registers, address0x20 and universal three-byte motor/servo packets
findings.action: Replaced with observed manufacturer source contract,0x48/0x49,exact arithmetic/corner-case notes; no tested C implementation claim.

findings.issue: SH1106 charge pump command incorrectly assigned0x8D; horizontal SSD1306 addressing sent to SH1106
findings.action: Use SH1106 AD/8A-8B and page addressing for confirmed SH1106; migrate old examples explicitly.

findings.issue: ADC removed-in-v5 and Controller legacy-only claims contradict official SDK5.5.4 migration documentation
findings.action: Legacy is deprecated but available in5.5.4; choose by SDK/application, not board name.

findings.issue: microAI connection/training docs and generic SoC descriptions cannot establish deployable microAI Plus support
findings.action: Keep first microAI and Plus separate; preserve deployment gate until BSP/runtime is implemented and tested.

findings.issue: Historical text says hardware-verified/100% without associated current-repository hardware test artifact
findings.action: Label historical author assertions separately from tests run on this repository.

primary_sources.title: INEX iKB-1Z implementation
primary_sources.supports: Default0x48/jumper-open0x49, command words, digital/ADC/motor/servo/serial operations; negative-angle and zero-reverse arithmetic need explicit porting policy.

primary_sources.title: SH1106 V2.3 controller datasheet, distributor mirror
primary_sources.supports: ADh DC-DC control;8Ah off/8Bh on;page/column addressing.

primary_sources.title: INEX KidBright32iA product
primary_sources.supports: Current product description names LDR and iA-MC3479; not proof all historical boards have that chip.

primary_sources.title: INEX KidBright32iP product
primary_sources.supports: ESP32, phototransistor, external connector group naming; does not resolve SW2 GPIO conflict.

primary_sources.title: INEX KidBright microAI Plus product
primary_sources.supports: SG2002/QMI8658A platform; distinct from prior generic microAI claims.

primary_sources.title: Espressif SDK5.5.4 ADC migration guide
primary_sources.supports: Legacy ADC exists but is deprecated; new oneshot/continuous families are supported.

limitations: No board flashed, connected or physically tested in this audit.
No claim that all historical model names, dates, MCU identities or revision-equivalence assertions are correct.
This is not a complete per-block translation coverage audit; another task covers the block catalog.
Line references under evidence_before_correction and observations may refer to the pre-correction snapshot; root agent is concurrently updating other rule files.
Unrelated board names in third-party dependencies/plugins are outside this application-board inventory.
